markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (66%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability check flagged the input [F6], the conformal set holds two classes, and MUSK disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 66%, Benign 34% | Normal leads, Benign close |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.36 / 44th percentile | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Normal (40% agree) | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Strongest term in concept model, lowers invasive association [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Only concept raising invasive association here [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Score typical, not elevated; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Small lowering association · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: CI includes 0 (0.002; −0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Case leans on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation distorts embeddings, making the Normal call and probabilities less trustworthy.
- True class is Benign; the classes overlap and MUSK picks a different top class.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 9, 10:** confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept's spot check failed.
2. **Region 7:** check stroma for true infiltration, the sole invasive-leaning concept.
3. **Region 2:** look for atypical cells confined to ducts; concept check only 12/20.
